question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Secresy'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Secrecy'.**
 
• The word '**Secrecy**' is a **noun** which means 'the act of keeping something secret or the state of being kept secret'. **(गोपनीयता)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The secrecy surrounding the project raised many questions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Secresy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let’s understand the meanings of the other marked words -**

 
• **Hypocrisy -** the practice of claiming to have moral standards or beliefs to which one’s own behavior does not conform. **(पाखंड)**
 
• **Cruelly -** in a manner that causes pain or suffering. **(निर्दयता)**
 
• **Luggage -** suitcases or other bags in which to pack personal belongings for traveling. **(सामान)**
